no-restricted-properties.message: Use object spread instead of Object.assign.
Define the value where it is created, or use vi.stubGlobal in tests.
Define the values where they are created, or use vi.stubGlobal in tests.
Use an object literal or a Map instead of Object.create.
Do not change an object's prototype.
Keep immutability in types instead of freezing at runtime.
Do not lock objects at runtime.
Do not lock objects at runtime.
Use a typed fixture or vi.stubGlobal instead of reading a property descriptor.
